title: Hexalith.Memories release package inventory
description: Approved package inventory consumed by tools/validate-release-packages.ps1, tools/pack-release.ps1, and tools/publish-nuget.ps1. Misspellings here would otherwise only surface at pack/publish time.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor and validator tool support.

packages.description: Approved packable projects published to nuget.org. Order is informational; the validator compares as a set.

packageId.description: NuGet package id; must match <PackageId> in the project file with case-sensitive equality (NuGet locks first-published casing).

project.description: Repo-relative path to the .csproj using forward slashes; must live under src/ and end in .csproj.

nonPackableProjects.description: Projects under src/ that intentionally declare <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>. Required so a new non-packable project cannot silently bypass inventory enforcement.

items.description: Repo-relative path to the .csproj using forward slashes; must live under src/ and end in .csproj.
